tasks.description: Create a virtual environment for the project.
Install necessary libraries (if any, though standard Python libraries should suffice for terminal I/O).
Develop the core game logic: game board representation, snake movement, food generation, collision detection.
Implement terminal rendering: clearing the screen and drawing the game state (snake, food, boundaries).
Implement non-blocking keyboard input handling for WASD movement.
Implement the main game loop: handling input, updating state, rendering, and checking game over conditions.
